scope: prepare-focused.cjs verifyResults only; no engine invocation, game modification, or fixture modification by verifier repair

originalVerification.classification: Verifier false negative; not a candidate or baseline engine failure
originalVerification.failedCheck: Baseline did not fail at the intended assertion
originalVerification.rootCause: Exact substring required one space after str:, while actual FastQSP stderr used two spaces.
originalVerification.oldMatcher: stderr.includes(str: plus one space plus quoted marker)

repair.newMatcher: Anchored showMessage(), str: followed by whitespace and a quoted marker; require exactly the intended single message.

verification.baselineActualRunnerMetadata: Original baseline client-results.json was overwritten by candidate execution; no baseline metadata reconstructed. Root will rerun baseline-plan.json and corrected verifier against fresh native runner metadata.
